title: Crimson Chamber Figure
description: A person with long dark curly hair stands with their back to the viewer in the center of a dilapidated, decaying room bathed in intense red and purple light. A wooden table in the foreground holds an old trumpet, a glass bottle, papers, and a small skull, while a worn wooden chair sits empty against the stained, peeling walls.
prompt: A solitary figure with long curly black hair wearing a dark red velvet jacket stands with their back to the viewer in a derelict room with peeling walls and ominous stains. In the foreground, a wooden table holds an old brass trumpet, glass bottle, papers, and a small skull. An empty wooden chair sits to the right. The entire scene is dramatically lit in intense blood-red and purple hues creating a heavy, mysterious atmosphere.
